a.xlink:title: Sets the card to be displayed and updates the pixmap.

Emitted when a pixmap for this card has been updated or finished loading.
Marks the pixmap as dirty and triggers a widget repaint.
Anchors the pill on the printed P/T box, or the expanded stack above it.
Whether the local player may edit the current card (own card, judge, writable zone).
Rect of the drawn artwork inside this widget.
